about:
# FMOD Hacker
Customizing FMOD Settings to Your Liking

## Features
- Change Sample Rate
- Change Audio Buffer Size
- Change Audio Device (AUTO, WASAPI, ASIO) (Windows only)
    - Use ASIO for zero latency (audio interface or virtual ASIO required)
    - Without Audio Interface or Virtual ASIO, THIS FEATURE WILL NOT WORK AT ALL!!
- Change Game's Master Volume

By setting the device to ASIO through this mod and using it in conjunction with Click Sound mod, you can obtain lag-free sound.
